**What checks out:**
- Every price matches `published-starting-prices.ts`.
- The 30% rate, £705 (£600 + £105), the discounted rows (£555, £405, £255), £105, the bespoke rows, £6,200 (12 months) and £4,100 (standard-v1, 6 months) all match `partner-programme.ts`, `standardCommissionTerms` and `docs/expansion/intelligence/ARCHITECTURE.md`. The payment schedules (£1,000/£1,000 and £750/£1,250) match `APPROVED_STANDARD_SCHEDULES`.
- The £250 referral reward matches `REFERRAL_REWARD_PENCE`.
- All seven meeting types match `MEETING_TYPES`. "One to five preferred times" and "nothing is booked until confirmed" match `requestMeeting` and `MEETING_TRANSITIONS`.
- The referral code and attribution flow matches `expansion-programme.ts`.
- Every client name and project description (Confirm-A-Kill, CSDS, The Business Circle, Prymal, Glow Tanning, Pinkys Prints, VeteranFinder) matches `data.ts` and `faq-library.ts`. There are no invented testimonials or results.
- No content uses a currency other than GBP or a converted price.
- CircleCard, the dedicated email address, Website Intelligence, Sales Studio and Ask ScaleSmiths are not presented as available anywhere.
- No compulsory-training language. Counts are correct: 13 courses, 38 modules, 91 lessons, 65 checks, 46 KB entries.

### Findings

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| F1 | MUST-FIX | KNOWLEDGE-BASE.md:396 (KB-PROG-09) | "Anyone may apply from anywhere, and you may talk to businesses in any country. ScaleSmiths can only accept a client contract in a market it has approved" | Partners are also gated on their **own operating market**. `assertCommercialClearance` (admin/src/lib/server/expansion.ts:98-107) refuses stage changes, discovery and scope unless both the customer market and the partner's operating market are approved. The gate applies from the first stage, not only at contract. Outreach is also blocked (`AP-LEG-03`, C07). | "Anyone may apply from any country. You can progress an opportunity only when ScaleSmiths has approved both your operating market and the client's market; the current list is shown in Getting started. Until a marketing process is approved, work only through your own network and introductions. Contracts and prices are in GBP." |
| F2 | MUST-FIX | KNOWLEDGE-BASE.md:348 (KB-PROG-03) | "the contact, country and industry are optional but the client's country is needed before a contract can be accepted" | Country is optional at registration (`normaliseCountry` returns null). After that, every partner move except closing lost or withdrawing needs an approved customer market. That covers stage changes, discovery and submit scope (expansion.ts:199-213). | "…the contact, country and industry are optional at registration, but the opportunity cannot move past Registered until the client's country is recorded and that market is approved." |
| F3 | SHOULD-FIX | LESSONS-PRACTICE.md:35 (C07-L7) | "If the portal shows 'commercial checks in progress', that is all you will be told." | No such text exists in the portal. The partner badge always reads "Commercial checks are completed by a founder before any commitment is made." (ExpansionWorkspace.tsx:420). A blocked move returns "This opportunity is awaiting commercial approval from a founder. You will be told when it can progress." (expansion.ts:97). Exclusivity is never evaluated for partner requests (expansion.ts:105-107). | "If the portal says an opportunity is awaiting commercial approval from a founder, that is all you will be told. Sector and area exclusivity is checked by founders at scope approval; the details are confidential." |
| F4 | SHOULD-FIX | resources/R09-meeting-preparation-checklist.md:12 | "no 'commercial checks' notice is unresolved" | Same as F3. The "Commercial checks…" badge shows on every open opportunity, so this item can never be ticked. | "…and the portal does not show it as awaiting commercial approval from a founder." |

The software does support per-partner, founder-set allowances (ExpansionWorkspace.tsx:337), but no allowance is approved (R12:40, `AP-COM-05`). | KB-PROG-06: "No discount allowance has been approved for any partner. The software supports founder-set allowances, but none exists until a founder records one under Commission and reserves it against an approved opportunity. Never offer or hint at a reduced price; route the request to commercial_assistance. *[FOUNDER DECISION `AP-COM-05`]*" |
| F6 | SHOULD-FIX | KNOWLEDGE-BASE.md:364, 368 (KB-PROG-05) | "For bespoke or technical work, request a technical scoping meeting" / "Escalation: when the work is bespoke → `technical_scoping`" | R10:17, C06-L7 and KB-CRM-01/SW-01 route bespoke work to `bespoke_discovery`. The portal labels it "Bespoke software discovery" (ExpansionWorkspace.tsx:136). | "For technical work request Technical scoping; for a workflow, system or bespoke build request Bespoke software discovery." Escalation: "when the work is bespoke → `bespoke_discovery`; when technical → `technical_scoping`." |
| F7 | SHOULD-FIX | CURRICULUM.md:342 (C11-L7); also LESSONS-PRACTICE.md:193 and R12:60 | "No market is approved yet" | This is a point-in-time claim. FOUNDER-LAUNCH-CHECKLIST item 4 requires GB to be approved before launch, and KB-PROG-09 points to the live list in Getting started (`approved_markets` step, partner-journey.ts). | CURRICULUM: "Markets are approved one by one; check the current list in Getting started; GBP only." Keep the "starts with no market approved" line in LESSONS-PRACTICE.md:193 and R12:60 as default behaviour, and add "check the current list in Getting started". |
| F8 | SHOULD-FIX | LESSONS-PRACTICE.md:213 (C12-L2) | "the draft programme uses 'Independent Business Partner'" | `PROGRAMME.opportunity = "Global Independent Business Partner"` (partner-programme.ts) | "the draft programme uses 'Global Independent Business Partner'" (the title itself is still pending `AP-GOV-05`). |
| F9 | SHOULD-FIX | KNOWLEDGE-BASE.md:332, 337 (KB-PROG-01) | "Growth Partnerships (SEO, AI search visibility and website improvement)…" marked "`CONFIRMED: PUBLISHED`" | AI-search wording is unapproved (`AP-CNT-06`; KB-AIS-01 is `FOUNDER DECISION`). The cited source, `web/src/app/partners/page.tsx`, is a draft page (R02:8, C01-L4). | Either remove "AI search visibility", or keep it and change the status to "`DRAFT`, `FOUNDER DECISION` (`AP-CNT-06`)". |
| F10 | SHOULD-FIX (promise of results) | KNOWLEDGE-BASE.md:135 (KB-SEO-03) | "Technical fixes can help quickly; the bigger gains build over months." | faq:seo-timeline makes no promise of gains ("measured over months, not weeks… Anyone quoting a fixed timescale… is guessing"). | "Technical fixes can change things quickly; content and authority work is measured over months, and nobody can honestly promise a fixed timescale." |
| F11 | NOTE | resources/R12-commission-and-payment-reference.md:52; KNOWLEDGE-BASE.md:286 (KB-COMM-02) | "Withdrawal requests are built but **not operational**" | The code is accurate here: `WithdrawalCentre` and `expansion_withdrawal_policies` exist, with no enabled policy. The public `FEATURE_AVAILABILITY` label, however, is "PLANNED". | "Withdrawal requests are planned and not operational: no frequency, minimum, invoicing or VAT policy is approved. *[FOUNDER DECISION]*" |
| F12 | NOTE (GBP) | resources/R01-company-brochure.md:37 | The boundary ends at "Prices are in GBP." | `STARTING_PRICE_BOUNDARY` continues "We do not bill in other currencies or publish fixed converted prices." R11:23 says to quote it as written. | Use the full `STARTING_PRICE_BOUNDARY` text. |
| F13 | NOTE | resources/R02-partner-handbook.md:33 | "Sign in on the ScaleSmiths admin site." | `partnerLoginUrl()` gives https://partners.scalesmiths.co.uk/login | "Sign in at partners.scalesmiths.co.uk." |
| F14 | NOTE | KNOWLEDGE-CHECKS.md:254 (C07-L3 q1) | "A prospect asks how long your lead protection lasts." | Lead protection is a partner term. C12-L6 and C11-L6 say partner terms are not discussed with clients. | "Another partner asks how long lead protection lasts. What do you say?" |
| F15 | NOTE | LESSONS-FOUNDATIONS.md:228, 260-266; CURRICULUM.md:166 | Named published clients | All names are present in `data.ts` and `faq-library.ts`, and the descriptions match. | No text change. Keep these unpublished until `AP-PROOF-01` is approved. |

Every open founder decision is correctly marked as blocked or proposed: withdrawals (apart from the F11 label), refunds and cancellation (KB-COMM-03, KB-PROG-13, R12:48), lead protection (C07-L3, KB-PROG-04, R02:41), the marketing process (C07, R02:45), the agreement, and reward terms (R12:56, KB-PROG-10/11).

### Counts
- MUST-FIX: 2 (F1, F2)
- SHOULD-FIX: 8 (F3 to F10)
- NOTE: 5 (F11 to F15)

### Verdict per content set
- **Academy (curriculum, lessons, 65 checks):** accurate on prices, commission and optional status. Fix the portal wording in C07-L7 (F3), the dated market claim (F7) and the programme title (F8).
- **Resources R01 to R13:** figures and commission maths are correct. Fix the R09 checklist item (F4) and align the R11 discount line with KB-PROG-06 (F5); the rest are minor wording notes.
- **Knowledge base (46 entries):** the service entries are clean. KB-PROG-09 and KB-PROG-03 misdescribe how the market gate works and must be fixed (F1, F2). KB-PROG-05, -06 and -01 and KB-SEO-03 need alignment (F5, F6, F9, F10).
- **Objections (R08, 12 entries):** accurate, with no guarantees, invented proof or unpublished prices. The only issue is that the "never discount" line conflicts with KB-PROG-06 (F5).
